mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM model_runtime.provider_connection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status <> 'DISABLED'

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, provider_kind, display_name, endpoint, region, authentication_type, credential_reference, status, version, last_probe_succeeded, last_probe_code, last_probed_at, created_at FROM model_runtime.provider_connection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, provider_kind, display_name, endpoint, region, authentication_type, credential_reference, status, version, last_probe_succeeded, last_probe_code, last_probed_at, created_at FROM model_runtime.provider_connection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, provider_kind, display_name, endpoint, region, authentication_type, credential_reference, status, version, last_probe_succeeded, last_probe_code, last_probed_at, created_at FROM model_runtime.provider_connection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (created_at, id) < (#{createdAt}, #{id}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
